explain: Lugard oversaw the 1914 amalgamation creating modern Nigeria.

q: The name 'Nigeria' was suggested by Flora Shaw (later Lady Lugard) from the phrase '____'. (P5)

q: Nigeria officially gained independence from British colonial rule on October 1, ____. (P5)

q: The first Prime Minister of independent Nigeria in 1960 was Sir ____. (P5)
explain: Sir Abubakar Tafawa Balewa led the federal cabinet as Prime Minister from 1957 to 1966.
